categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Fuzzing label and adds a new fuzz harness in src/test/fuzz/p2p_transport_serialization.cpp
categories.rationale: Adds fuzz coverage for high-risk p2p message handling paths that fuzzers currently do not reach. The target exercises BIP 324 V2Transport receive states and error handling against arbitrary byte streams past the initial handshake, addressing an area directly targeted at hostile peer traffic.
